g.text: WEAVER / AUTHORITATIVE CANONICAL ORIGIN / CROSS-PROTOCOL RECOVERY

text.tspan: Reconnect / new task / resume / reply loss
Alias collision / stale owner / ledger rollback
Immutable origin / alias keys / pending intent
New task is not a fresh claim
Lookup is data / not a send grant
Restart closes access and retires receipts
Unknown work remains spent and held
New protocol is not a funding domain
